heading_en: Calculation of the Operational Risk Equivalent Amount
summary_ja: オペレーショナル・リスク相当額は標準的計測手法で算出し、その対象は法人単位とする。
summary_en: The operational risk equivalent amount is calculated using the standardized measurement approach, applied on an entity-unit basis.
paragraphs: In calculating the operational risk equivalent amount, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company shall use the standardized measurement approach.

The standardized measurement approach shall apply on an entity-unit basis (meaning the Ultimate Designated Parent Company and its consolidated subsidiary corporations, etc.; the same applies in Article 285).
